heading: Key Sources
title: NP Circle
note: online community for NPs and NP students in Canada and the US: discussion forum, case sharing and mentorship; free to join, with paid accredited courses

heading: Key Sources
title: NNPBC - NP Primary Care Integration Program (NP-PIP)
note: a community of practice, mentorship and coaching for BC NPs in longitudinal primary care

heading: Project ECHO Programs
title: BC Centre on Substance Use - BC ECHO on Substance Use
note: monthly case-based video sessions for primary care physicians and NPs; accredited for continuing education

heading: Project ECHO Programs
title: Pain BC - BC ECHO for Chronic Pain
note: free, virtual community of practice for BC health care providers: monthly one-hour sessions over four months

heading: Project ECHO Programs
title: Interior Health - Project ECHO
note: Interior Health's ECHO programs for clinicians in the region

heading: How to Do It in BC
title:
1. Join [NP Circle](https://npcircle.ca/) for a national peer network.
2. If you work in longitudinal primary care, contact [NNPBC NP-PIP](https://www.nnpbc.com/practice-supports/np-pip/) about its community of practice and mentorship.
3. Register for an ECHO series that matches your caseload.
